fascinating.en: Hello, hello, hello, and welcome to English Learning for Curious Minds, by Leonardo English, the show where you can listen to fascinating stories and learn weird and wonderful things about the world at the same time as improving your English.
fascinating.zh: 大家好，欢迎收听由 Leonardo English 制作的《English Learning for Curious Minds》。在这个节目中，你可以一边收听引人入胜的故事、了解世界上奇妙而不可思议的事物，一边提升你的英语水平。

fashionable.en: French cuisine became really fashionable in Britain, among the wealthy classes anyway.
fashionable.zh: 法国菜在英国确实变得很时髦，无论如何是在富裕阶层中。

farmer.en: They just complained about it. I took them to a farmers market that popped up near the university every Wednesday, and I bought them some pies.
farmer.zh: 他们只是盲目抱怨。于是我带他们去了每周三在大学附近摆摊的农贸市场，给他们买了几只派。
